# fold

Wrap text lines for MoonX.

```sh
moonx cli/fold@0.1.5 [OPTION]... [FILE]...
```

## Supported scope

Wrap files or stdin at 80 columns by default, preserving bytes and an unterminated final line.

## Options

<!-- BEGIN GENERATED OPTIONS -->
<!-- Generated by tools/metadata from options.json. -->

| Option | Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `-b` / `--bytes` | none | count bytes rather than columns |
| `-c` / `--characters` | none | count characters in the C-locale byte profile |
| `-s` / `--spaces` | none | break after the last available blank |
| `-w` / `--width` | required | use WIDTH columns instead of 80 Default: `80`. |
| `--help` | none | Show help / package version. |
| `--version` | none | Show help / package version. |
<!-- END GENERATED OPTIONS -->

## Limitations

- Character and display-width modes use the C-byte profile; multibyte Unicode counting is unsupported.

## Examples

```sh
moonx cli/fold@0.1.5 -w 72 notes.txt
moonx cli/fold@0.1.5 -s -w 40 notes.txt
```
